For <=6 frequencies all minimal dependencies have even size 4 or 6; the only six-point rank4 types are 4-circuit+2 independent and pure 6-circuit. Exact direct averages: 4-circuit M3 16 vs 8; 5 with independent sign 79/4 vs 14; 6 with 4-circuit 25 vs 20; pure 6-circuit 21 vs 24. At affine rank3, a six-point subset complements two of eight cube vertices and orthogonality forces M3=30 or20. For d<=3, cardinality7 follows from pointwise convex chord on possible squared magnitudes, cardinality8 from L_infinity<=8 and L2^2=8. Independent exhaustive integer enumeration of all normalized signings for every support containing zero confirms zero reversals for all d=3 support sizes and 2688 reversing normalized six-character cases in dimension4, all exact six-circuit sign products. The infinite d classification follows analytically from rank reduction, not finite testing.
